score.label: Your score
score.note: Each bar fills in as its checks finish. Your score lands when the last one does.

verdicts.message: Mostly healthy, with a few things I’d fix soon.
Holding up, but a few things need attention.

review.heading: Now let me take a look.
review.body: The score covers what a script can see. Leave your email and I’ll go through the site myself, then send a one-page report: what’s healthy, what’s at risk, and what I’d fix first.
review.label: Email
review.note: No cost and no obligation. If your site is in good shape, I’ll tell you that too.
review.error: That didn’t send. Try again, or email me at

errors.bad-email: That doesn’t look like an email address. Check it for typos and try again.
errors.disposable-email: That looks like a temporary inbox. Could you use an address you check? That’s where I’ll send the report.
errors.no-mail-server: That domain doesn’t seem to receive email. Check the address for typos.
errors.email-limit: I’ve already received a few requests from that address today. Check your inbox, or try again tomorrow.
errors.already-requested: I’ve already got a review request for this check. Look for the confirmation email.
errors.rate-limited: That’s a lot of requests. Give it a little while and try again.

sent.label: Check your inbox
sent.heading: *Almost there.* Confirm your email.
sent.message: I’ve sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm, and I’ll send your report once I’ve been through {{host}} myself. It expires in an hour.
sent.booking: Rather talk it through? Book a 20-min call

expired.title: That link has expired.
expired.message: Confirmation links work once and last an hour. Run the site check again to get a new one, or email {{supportEmail}}.

prompt.title: Confirm your review request.
prompt.message: One more click and I’ll go through your site myself.

failed.title: That didn’t send.
failed.message: Sorry, something went wrong on my end. Email me at {{supportEmail}}.

confirmed.title: You’re confirmed.
confirmed.message: You’re all set—thanks. I’ll go through {{host}} myself and send what I find to {{email}}.

confirmation.subject: Confirm your review request for {{host}}
confirmation.intro: You asked me to take a personal look at {{host}}. Before I dig in, I just want to make sure you’re a real person and have access to this email address:
confirmation.expiry: The link works once and expires in an hour. If you didn’t request this, you can ignore it—nothing else will happen.

review.subject: Site check review: {{host}} ({{score}})
review.attachment: Each check’s evidence is attached as JSON. Reply to answer them directly.
